text:
marco: quick sync: customer pushed back on ambiguity in our private-deploy checklist. they want a single page preflight that netops can hand to SRE and legal for signoff.

anya: what's "single page" mean here? condensed output?

marco: yes. human-readable pass/fail + 1-line remediation per failure + a tiny JSON manifest for audit. they want it emailed to security if opt-in.

tyler: important: the manifest must not leak IPs or usernames. propose we collect only install_hash, agent_semver, kernel_major, ipv4_reachability_status (PASS/FAIL), bgp_ok (PASS/FAIL), egress_ports_verified (list), telemetry_optin (true/false).

ashley: legal asked for explicit consent wording. sample: "I consent to share anonymized install telemetry with Redwood for support purposes." checkbox + timestamp.

marco: also: upgrade path ask. They want a path that guarantees no more than 2 rolling restarts for minor patches and an automated safe-rollback if health-check fails.

anya: propose two launch criteria bullets: 1) preflight tool + manifest schema published; 2) upgrade-lane automation tested on our lab cluster with simulated driver mismatch. both must be documented in the runbook.

eng-bot: NOTE: created ticket INF-8242 (private-preflight-tooling) assigned to tyler.

tyler: for rollback we'll implement: staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic halt on >3% error rate or node-suspended state. rollback plan will include snapshot restore step and kernel-driver compatibility check.

ashley: can we define MTTR for rollbacks? customer wants an SLA clause.

anya: propose MTTR target: <= 1h for the cautious lane, <=15m for the fast lane (assuming relay fallback is available).

marco: note on relay: relay must live on port 443 and be allowed via minimal firewall rules. some customers will only permit outbound 80/443. include a relay-only test in preflight.

tyler: I'll add a relay smoke test: attempt TLS handshake to relay endpoint and verify proxy headers are preserved.

eng-bot: DEPLOYMENT-TEST: relay.smoke started against staging-relay-1. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/tests/relay-smoke/1822223333

ashley: security/legal: add a requirement that the manifest includes a cryptographic proof (HMAC) of the installer binary the customer ran (so they can verify chain of custody).

tyler: ok, HMAC of artifact + timestamp signed by our CI will be included; nothing else.

anya: UX: console should show preflight status, one-line remediation hints, and a download button for the manifest and signed consent. Minimal design: status pill (PASS/WARN/FAIL), failures expandable.

marco: prioritization: we consider this "onramp-must" if the customer is on an enterprise contract. timeline ask: PoC in 1 week, complete runbook + tests in 6 weeks.

ashley: legal wants opt-in wording + sample clause for the contract. I'll draft and post here.

tyler: tech owners: I'll own the tool + smoke tests; anya owns runbook + console UI; marco owns rollout strategy and customer comms.

marco: acceptance criteria for shipping:
- preflight script binary + source published
- manifest JSON schema published and validated by two customers
- console display + download flow implemented
- upgrade lanes documented + automated rollback tests pass in lab
- legal consent text and HMAC proof included

eng-bot: REMINDER: weekly onramp sync scheduled Thu 09:00.

marco: next step: tyler to post PoC artifact link here within 48h. we'll re-evaluate priorities if any blocker shows up. :rocket:
